Principle: a bound stops hostile amplification and never refuses a big legitimate print file; every refusal typed.

Limits: per stream refuse decoded > 2 GiB, or decoded > 256 MiB at decoded/encoded > 1024; images up to 150 Mpx at any colour space and bit depth; a 4 GiB per-call budget, no whole-document total; 50,000,000 operators per stream; a bad Flate tail keeps base behaviour with a warning. Required passes: 300 dpi A3 Flate CMYK 8 and 16 bit, A2 RGB 300 dpi JPEG and Flate. Required refusals: a 1 KiB stream inflating past 256 MiB, a 200 Mpx image.
Encryption is out of scope: base behaviour on every route that read encrypted files before.
